title: EOS Golden Spec-Driven Development Blueprint
description: Master reference blueprint for the 9-phase autonomous, governed Spec-Driven & Agentic Engineering lifecycle

lifecycle_phases.name: Vision & Business Goal Formulation
lifecycle_phases.objective: Capture high-level problem statement, business objectives, stakeholder constraints and epistemic risk tiers without premature implementation

lifecycle_phases.name: 10-Domain Technical Discovery & Stack Selection
lifecycle_phases.objective: Inspect target environment in 10 domains and evaluate multicriteria architectural trade-offs with reversibility index

lifecycle_phases.name: Formal Specification & JSON Schema Contracts
lifecycle_phases.objective: Define domain entities, interface contracts, JSON Schemas Draft 2020-12 and endpoint boundaries before writing code

lifecycle_phases.name: First-Principles Architecture & Anti-Bloat Design
lifecycle_phases.objective: Synthesize minimal hexagonal/screaming architecture and apply first-principles de-complexity pruning

lifecycle_phases.name: Topological Task DAG Decomposition & Pareto Routing
lifecycle_phases.objective: Break down implementation into atomic task contracts, calculate Kahn topological waves, and route tasks to Pareto-optimal model tiers

lifecycle_phases.name: Hermetic TDD Sandbox Execution & FDIR Self-Healing
lifecycle_phases.objective: Execute tasks in isolated worktree sandboxes under strict Red-Green-Refactor with automated FDIR fault isolation

lifecycle_phases.name: Adversarial Red-Teaming & Deterministic Chaos Drills
lifecycle_phases.objective: Subject generated code to 6 adversarial attack vectors and seeded chaos fault injections to prove resilience

lifecycle_phases.name: Epistemic Verification & Immutable Ledger Recording
lifecycle_phases.objective: Audit all evidence receipts, verify zero-secret leakage, and record cryptographic event into append-only SHA-256 ledger

lifecycle_phases.name: Continuous Learning & BKM Knowledge Distillation
lifecycle_phases.objective: Extract proven architectural patterns, scrub sensitive tokens, and distill immutable BKM records for cross-mission transfer

governance_invariants: NODE_BUILTINS_ONLY (Zero production npm dependencies in core control plane)
HERMETIC_SANDBOX_ISOLATION (Zero unauthorized writes to base repository)
